decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter remained on the website in both 2023 and 2024, fitting the firm's push in organic cold cuts and indicating continued relevance in the assortment.
The organic poultry mini salami snacks had their own page at launch in 2023 but were no longer mentioned in 2024, which strongly suggests weak traction or a deliberate phase-out.
The premium salami snack for sharing was still mentioned in 2024 after its 2023 launch, and snackable premium salami is close to the firm's core strengths in convenient meat specialties.
The organic boiled pork sausage was newly launched in 2024 on its own page and directly supports the firm's stated expansion of its organic range, so it should be given more time in market.
The organic thinly sliced chicken breast was prominently launched in 2024 with its own page and broadens the firm's ingredient-conscious organic offer in a format that suits retail shoppers.
The organic herb-coated salami was presented on its own page in 2024 and is a natural extension of the firm's established salami and seasoning expertise, making continuation the sensible choice.
